sources.title: Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B | vLLM Recipes
sources.snippet: The official Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 checkpoint serves directly on a 950PR — no offline re-quantization and no --quantization ascend. vLLM Ascend reads quant_method: fp8 and weight_block_size straight from the checkpoint, expands the weight_scale_inv tiles at load time and re-quantizes to MXFP8 on 950.

sources.title: Qwen 3.8 27B - GroqDocs
sources.snippet: Model card for Qwen3.8-27B: a compact 27B multimodal (vision + text) model with thinking and instruct modes, frontier-level agentic coding, long-horizon tool use, and near-instant responses on Groq.

sources.title: Qwen3.8 - How to Run Locally | Unsloth Documentation
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8 is Qwen's new model family, featuring Qwen3.8- 27B, Qwen3.8- 2.4T-A95B and Qwen3.8- Max. Qwen3.8-27B has vision and reasoning capabilities, a 256K context window, and runs locally on 17GB RAM/VRAM setups. Qwen3.8 excels at agentic coding, vision and chat tasks, and can now run via Unsloth GGUFs, NVFP4 and Unsloth Desktop.
